definitions.explanation: The act of buying goods or services. More formal than {買|か}い{物|もの} and often used in business, economics, and institutional contexts.

examples.japanese: {購買力|こうばいりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{購買|こうばい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a notebook at the school store.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{購買|こうばい}⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えている→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: Online advertising has a significant impact on consumer purchasing behavior.

notes:
More formal and institutional than ⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧ (shopping). Used in economics, business, and school contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {購買力|こうばいりょく} (purchasing power)
- {購買|こうばい}⟦{意欲|いよく}→意欲：05317_iyoku⟧ (desire to buy)
- {購買|こうばい}⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧ (purchasing behavior)
- {購買|こうばい}{部|ぶ} (purchasing department)

In schools, {購買|こうばい} (or {購買部|こうばいぶ}) often refers to the school store or co-op shop where students can buy stationery and snacks.
